_README: Runbook §230. Keys of scripts/_reattr_owners.json (the static 2026-08 owners cache that apply_owners_full re-asserts every night) that the GUARDED reader build_fundamentals.xbrl_profit does not reproduce from ANY consolidated XBRL of that quarter in the local cache (TCI split under the owners tag, owners 0 beside a real NCI, all-zero placeholder, EPS-failing split).

apply_owners_full SKIPS these keys: the stored value is left as it is (a quarantine changes no cell by itself); a wrong stored value is healed only through owners_basis_heals / fund_cell_fix after reading that cell's own filing.

Built 2026-10-22 by ~/stocks-cache/pipeline-bugs/quarantine.py over 104,538 cached XBRL files: 23,839 cache keys, 22,003 reproduced, 493 with no cached file (kept), 1,343 quarantined. Each entry: cache value, what the guarded reader returns per file (null = refused/none), the files.
